title: Drilling of mounting holes
description: Drilling of mounting holes capability for titanium components
processDescription: Laser drilling of titanium uses pulsed laser energy to create precise holes through percussion or trepanning methods. Hole diameters range from 0.05 mm to 3 mm with aspect ratios up to 20:1, specifically for titanium components. Precision titanium components  present unique challenges: Balancing dimensional accuracy with cost per part. Process selection (mill vs. turn vs. EDM vs. laser) optimized for each feature.
heatControl: Pulsed fiber laser with nitrogen assist gas. Pulse energy and frequency controlled to minimize recast layer.
flatnessControl: Non-contact process; no mechanical distortion. Vacuum fixturing for thin foil.
capabilitiesDescription: Integrated manufacturing capability for Drilling of mounting holes, supported by in-house QC, material certification, and engineering review.
